# Astryx

> Astryx is Meta's open source design system for React 19+, built on StyleX and designed for both people and AI agents. It ships 227 documented components, seven themes, page templates, and a CLI as one cohesive system. Consumers import pre-built CSS and typed React components — no build plugin required.

Generated from commit `a5333b2` (2026-09-02) of https://github.com/facebook/astryx.

Key facts:

- Requires React 19+; `react` and `react-dom` are peer dependencies of `@astryxdesign/core`.
- Install: `npm install @astryxdesign/core @astryxdesign/theme-neutral @stylexjs/stylex` plus `npm install -D @astryxdesign/cli`.
- Styles are authored in StyleX but overridable with plain `className` (Tailwind, CSS Modules, plain CSS).
- A theme is a set of CSS custom-property overrides; themes: butter, chocolate, gothic, matcha, neutral, probe, stone, y2k.
- `astryx swizzle <Name>` ejects a component's source into your project for deep customization.
- CLI bootstrap for agents: `astryx docs principles --dense`, `astryx docs tokens --dense`, `astryx docs theme --dense`, `astryx component --list`, `astryx component <Name> --dense`.
- Inputs are controlled: pass `value` + `onChange` (no `defaultValue`/`defaultChecked`). Wrap the app in `<Theme theme={neutralTheme}>` (theme object from `@astryxdesign/theme-*/built`).
- Layout spacing uses a numeric scale: `gap={4}` / `padding={6}` (steps 0–10), not `gap="md"`. Components have no `style` prop — use `xstyle` or size props (`width`, `maxWidth`).

## Packages

- [@astryxdesign/build](https://github.com/facebook/astryx/blob/main/packages/build/README.md): Build plugins for XDS source builds — babel, PostCSS, and Vite integrations
- [@astryxdesign/charts](https://github.com/facebook/astryx/blob/main/packages/charts/README.md): Astryx charts — a config-model data visualization library (d3-based). Published to npm only under the @canary dist-tag for early testing; never released as a stable (latest) version.
- [@astryxdesign/cli](https://github.com/facebook/astryx/blob/main/packages/cli/README.md): Scaffold projects, browse templates, generate themes, and get agent-ready docs from the command line.
- [@astryxdesign/core](https://github.com/facebook/astryx/blob/main/packages/core/README.md): The component library. Accessible, themeable React components with built-in spacing, dark mode, and StyleX styling.
- [@astryxdesign/lab](https://github.com/facebook/astryx/blob/main/packages/lab/README.md): Experimental Astryx components — published to npm only under the @canary dist-tag for early testing; never released as a stable (latest) version.
- [@astryxdesign/richtext](https://github.com/facebook/astryx/blob/main/packages/richtext/README.md): Astryx rich text — a Lexical-based rich text editor and viewer. Published to npm only under the @canary dist-tag for early testing; never released as a stable (latest) version.
- [@astryxdesign/vega](https://github.com/facebook/astryx/blob/main/packages/vega/README.md): Astryx Vega wrapper — chart and data visualization components. Published to npm only under the @canary dist-tag for early testing; never released as a stable (latest) version.

## Components

227 documented components in `packages/core/src/`. Each has a `{Name}.doc.mjs` structured doc with props, anatomy, and best practices. By category:

- Accessibility: useAnnounce
- Action: Button, ButtonGroup, Trigger area, ContextMenuItem, Trigger button, DropdownMenuCheckboxItem, DropdownMenuDivider, DropdownMenuItem, DropdownMenuRadioGroup, DropdownMenuRadioItem, DropdownMenuSubMenu, IconButton, Link, Trigger button, Control, SegmentedControlItem, ToggleButton, ToggleButtonGroup, Outer chrome
- Animation: useEntryAnimation
- Chat: Chat, ChatComposer, ChatComposerDrawer, ChatComposerInput, ChatComposerTokenElement, ChatDictationButton, ChatLayout, ChatLayoutScrollButton, ChatMessage, ChatMessageBubble, ChatMessageList, ChatMessageMetadata, ChatSendButton, ChatSystemMessage, ChatTokenizedText, ChatToolCalls
- Container: Card, Carousel, ClickableCard, Collapsible, CollapsibleGroup, SelectableCard
- Content: Avatar, AvatarStatusDot, AvatarGroup, AvatarGroupOverflow, Blockquote, Citation, Code, CodeBlock, EmptyState, Glyph, Shortcut, Document, Heading, Text, Thumbnail, Timestamp, Token
- Feedback & Status: Badge, Banner, Progress bar, Placeholder, Spinner, Dot
- Focus: useFocusTrap, useGridFocus, useIndicatorFocusRing, useKeyboardHint, useListFocus, useTreeFocus, useTypeahead
- Form Controls: Calendar, CheckboxInput, Group, CheckboxListItem, Field, DateInput, DateRangeInput, DateTimeInput, Field, FieldLabel, Message box, FileInput, Indicator, InputGroup, InputGroupText, Field, NumberInput, PowerSearch, RadioList, RadioListItem, Field, SelectorOption, Label, Field, Label, TextInput, TimeInput, Tokenizer, BaseTypeahead, Field, TypeaheadItem
- Interaction: useCollapsible, useHoverCard, useLayer, usePopover, useToast, useTooltip, useClickableContainer, useClipboard, useContainerReveal, useHotkeys, useInputContainer, useInputStatusIcon, useInteractiveRole, useLongPress
- Layout: AppShell, useAppShellMobile, AspectRatio, Center, Divider group, FormLayout, Grid container, GridSpan, Layout container, LayoutContent, LayoutFooter, LayoutHeader, LayoutPanel, Handle, useResizable, Section container, Stack container, useOverflow, useScrollLock, useScrollOverflow
- Media: useImageMode, useMediaQuery
- Navigation: BreadcrumbItem, Breadcrumbs, Navigation overlay, Container, Menu, Outline, Pagination, SideNav, SideNavCollapseButton, SideNavHeading, SideNavItem, SideNavSection, Step, Stepper, Tab, TabList, TabMenu, TopNav, TopNavHeading, TopNavItem, TopNavMegaMenu, TopNavMegaMenuFeaturedCard, TopNavMegaMenuItem, TopNavMenu
- Overlay: AlertDialog, useImperativeAlertDialog, Sheet panel, BottomSheetSwitcher, Dialog, CommandPaletteEmpty, CommandPaletteFooter, CommandPaletteGroup, CommandPaletteInput, CommandPaletteItem, CommandPaletteList, Dialog, DialogHeader, useImperativeDialog, HoverCard, Viewer overlay, Overlay, Popover, Toast, Tooltip surface
- Streaming: useStreamingText
- Table & List: Item, List, ListItem, MetadataList, MetadataListItem, List, Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableFooter, TableHeader, TableHeaderCell, TableRow, useTableColumnResize, useTableColumnSettings, useTableFilterState, useTableFiltering, useTableGroupedRows, useTablePagination, useTableRowExpansion, useTableRowIndex, useTableRowStatus, useTableSelection, useTableSelectionState, useTableSortable, useTableStickyColumns, useTableTreeData, useTableTreeState, Tree list
- Utilities: useCollator, useLocale, useTranslator
- Utility: Layer, LinkProvider, VisuallyHidden, useDevWarning, useMergedRefs, InternationalizationProvider, MediaTheme, SyntaxTheme, Theme, useTheme
